author: Claude
headline: Nvidia chip-shipment freeze weighs on AI stocks while global shares rally
summary: Global stocks rallied as investors shrugged off US tariffs and AI jitters and went to 'fish for bargains', but a headline about a Nvidia shipment freeze and US chip curbs put AI stocks under pressure. Nvidia is down 3.9% today, Micron 4.5%, ASML 2.5% and TSMC 2%. US markets are shut for Thanksgiving, so these moves are on thin trading. The backdrop still reads Cautious. The dip picks are led by TSMC, AMD, Freeport-McMoRan, Glencore, Netflix and UnitedHealth, with Nvidia (39% below its high), Intel, Dell and Arm also deeply marked down. Chip headlines can keep pushing these lower before they recover, so smaller buys spread the risk. Not financial advice.
points: Nvidia shipment freeze and US chip curbs put AI stocks under pressure: Nvidia -3.9%, Micron -4.5%, ASML -2.5%.
Global stocks rallied as investors shrugged off US tariffs; US tariff-hike threats pile pressure on partners to sign trade deals.
Miners are bouncing: Glencore up 3.8% today after Wednesday's sell-off.
Crypto: bitcoin little changed with DeFi tokens leading a bounce; bitcoin ETFs are bleeding cash.
